pics.title: Update : Profile Pictures
pics.intro: Add or update your own photos
pics.instructions:
Add/Remove photos or change album settings
You can add up to 10 photos to your personal album.
Added Photos will not be visible to others before being reviewed by Kobool moderators.
Photo will be rejected if it shows any of the following:
*Printed contact information (i.e.: email, phone number, web address )
*Photo for other persons or celebrities
*Pornographic images
-Lots of your skin (i.e.: shoulder, chest, legs )
-Nature images without you appearing in the frame
-Images for kids, animals or objects
-Duplicating the same photo with the same size
Note: Ignoring instructions with red color will lead to terminating your membership

visibility_help.option: This option will make your profile appears in the top search results when searching with "pics first" option. Also it is possible that visitors who are not members might register to be members if they like your picture.

This option will give your pictures some privacy. However, this will give your profile lower priority in the search results than who selected "Every one borwsing KOBOOL.com" when searching with "pics first" option.

This option will give your pictures more privacy, as you will show them to only whom you selected and whom you are interested in. However, this will give your profile lower priority in the search results than who selected "Only Active Members" when searching with "pics first" option.

This option will show your picture to only one person who you matched with via KOBOOL Acceptance Matching. However, this will give your profile lower priority in the search results than who selected "Only Members in your Acceptance List" when searching with "pics first" option.

This option will completely hide your picture from everyone ( except you of cours ). This is useful when you want to temporary hide your picture completely.However, this will give your profile the lowest priority in the search results when searching with "pics first" option.
